"}, {"insert": {"image": "https://storage.googleapis.com/indie-hackers.appspot.com/post-images/KreQWf7VhwxVW9calYa5/PWairgiOpneHvkGJri7RVbtORKI2/Bruce"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你有没有经历过——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一夜之间，你的生意 completely collapse？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不是市场变化。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不是竞争加剧。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "是平台封了你的账号。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你的钱被冻结。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你在一 new country，没有 access 你自己的 money。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Viktor Seraleev 经历过。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这是他三次"从零开始"中的一次。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在他的 app portfolio 月入超过6万美元。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【首先，他不知道自己想做什么】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Viktor 大学后不知道自己想做什么。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但有一件事 clear——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他不想 work traditional 9-5 job。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这让他没选择，只能 become entrepreneur。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他开始做 offline businesses，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但 over time，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " gradually shifted focus to online products"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " and digital businesses"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " where he could build、iterate、scale on his own terms。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在他是 indie mobile app developer 和 founder。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "从2020年开始建和 ship iOS 和 Android apps，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "主要在 photo/video、creative tools、utility 空间。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这些年来，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " launch 了30多个 apps，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " sold several of them，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " multiple times rebuilt his business from zero。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他目前运营 profitable portfolio，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "过去两年 consistent growth。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2025年12月，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " finishes 月收入超过6.01万美元——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " after Apple's commission。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【三次从零开始】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他不得不从零开始三次。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "First time", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "——2020年，离开 partners，决定 solo。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Second time", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "——因为他 couldn't build anything meaningful。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Bank 里有钱，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " saw it as perfect moment fully reset and rethink。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Third time", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "——最艰难的时期，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " personally 和 professionally。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "那是2022年。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他不得不从 Russia relocate 到 Chile，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " overnight，他的生意 fully international。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2022年2月前，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "约75%收入来自 Russia。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "那之后——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "降到 nearly zero。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "那 alone 是挑战，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但正当他开始 recover，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "遭遇了 true black swan event。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Apple 终止了他的开发者账号。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他花了八个月 try understand why。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最终发现——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " part ways 后，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他以前的 partners 注册了同名公司。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Apple 关闭了他们的账号，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " connection 导致他整个生意 collapse。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "He took Apple to court，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但法官 ruled account termination 是 standard contractual relationships 的一部分，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " entirely Apple's decision。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "同时，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "制裁导致他的 main bank 关闭公司账号、"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "冻结 funds。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他什么都没有了——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " new country，没有 access 他自己的 money。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这是他生命中最 stressful 和 painful 的时期之一。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "爬出那个 hole 花了巨大的 emotional 和 mental toll。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但这也 shaped 他今天的思考方式。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "He's not chasing chaos or constant restarts anymore。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在，他 most value stability、predictability、transparency。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他 fully work in open，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " build sustainable businesses in public，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " focus on long-term resilience rather than short-term wins。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【第一个成功的App：41万美元出售】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他的第一个 solo 产品来自 practical need。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2020年，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他和妻子经营家庭生意——美甲沙龙。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一天晚上，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "她试图创建一个简单的 Instagram 视频——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "美甲前后用 slider effect。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Surprisingly，她在 App Store 找不到这个用途的 app。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他一开始不信，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "自己 search。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "什么都没找到。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所以他设计了一个 simple UI，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "朋友帮他建了 app 的第一版。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Buggy 和 imperfect，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但 complete redesign 和几次 updates 后，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " app grew fast。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Just eight months，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "净收入从200美元增长到3.4万美元。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Eventually，他以41万美元出售了 app——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " without actively seeking a buyer。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Someone offered to buy it，and he accepted。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【个人挑战：一年建10个App】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Launch 个人挑战是他最有帮助的决策之一。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他给自己设了目标："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "年底前建10个 apps。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "那个 challenge 迫使他 adopt small bets 和 fast iterations 的策略。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "规则很简单："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Projects 必须 high quality。", "attributes": {"list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "它们必须 small but genuinely useful。", "attributes": {"list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Challenge 必须完成，no matter what。", "attributes": {"list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "完成后，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你不只是获得 valuable assets。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "更重要的是，你获得 real clarity。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你会学到："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Which projects are worth scaling", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Which ones to shut down or sell", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Where to actually invest your time and energy", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【原生 vs 跨平台开发】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他的技术栈选择 obvious。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "对于 video-related apps，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " native development works best，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所以他用 Swift。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有他自己的 in-house video rendering technology。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "That said，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他也实验。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "去年他 ship 了两个 apps——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一个用 Kotlin Multiplatform 建，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "另一个用 React Native。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Pleasantly surprised by how much cross-platform development"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " has improved over the years。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "If you're not working heavily with video，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "cross-platform development is absolutely the right choice。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【订阅 vs 广告】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他所有的 apps 都用 subscription model。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Apps 免费下载，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但用户为 premium features 付费。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "通常提供两个计划："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " weekly 和 yearly subscription。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "During major global sales"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " like Black Friday 或 end-of-year campaigns，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他 run limited discounts，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "通常 increase daily revenue by 30-40%。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他也 deliberately decided avoid ads in his apps entirely。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他不喜欢作为 user 的 advertising model，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所以 choose not use it in his products。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他坚持这个原则："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "建 clean、focused apps，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " revenue 直接来自 delivering value to users。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【移动增长的"秘方"】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这是他 consistently attract users"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " and grow mobile apps 的"secret sauce"。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "没什么 magical——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "只是可靠 channels，proven over time。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "ASO (App Store Optimization)：", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最稳定的 acquisition channels 之一。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "App Store search 产生约25%流量。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Basics matter most——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " strong title、subtitle、"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " carefully selected keywords。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Visibility on competitors' app pages 产生另外~10%。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Launch 时的 initial boost：", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他经常用简单公式——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " keyword + unique app name。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Check your app name 在 search 中怎么出现，before release。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这个方法不总是 work，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但上次 launch 后 generated 34 trials。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Personal blog 和 social media：", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他定期发关于 apps 和 journey 的帖子。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "One post alone reached 600k+ views on Twitter。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这个渠道对他 surprisingly consistent。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Google Ads：", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他测试了 multiple paid channels，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最终 focus on Google Ads。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "其他的要么太贵，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "要么 not profitable enough at scale。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "TikTok 和 Instagram Reels：", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他想亲自 create video content about his apps。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Last year，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他花了一个月每天发六个视频"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "（三个西班牙语，三个英语）。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Dozens of videos crossed 100k views，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " several reached 500k+，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " one passed 1.2M views。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "It works，但 very time-consuming"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " and consistency is hard to maintain。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Apple Search Ads：", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "在他开发者账号被终止前，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这是他的 main acquisition channel。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Currently on pause——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "在 photo/video niche，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " competition 把价格 drive very high。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Product Hunt：", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他偶尔在 Product Hunt launch apps。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "提供来自 loyal audience 的 early feedback"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "和 some initial traffic。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Good launch 需要 preparation。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【Never Give Up】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一件帮了他很多的事来自早年生活。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "成长过程中，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "父母一直教他一个简单规则——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " Never give up。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Stay strong，even when things are hard。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这个 mindset 帮他心理上 survived 最艰难的时刻，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "从零重建生意——多次。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他也不是独自做这件事。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "家人——妻子和孩子——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " always by his side。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Their support matters more than anything else，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " especially during unstable periods。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【透明的力量】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他的建议——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " Don't be afraid to be open。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Transparency is rare，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " but it's also what attracts people。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Be honest with your users、your team、"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " and the people around you。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Long-term trust matters more than short-term optics。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "And don't be afraid to make mistakes。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "The more approaches you try，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " the higher your chances of success。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Mistakes are unavoidable——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " he still makes them regularly。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "What matters is learning from them and adjusting，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " not avoiding failure at all costs。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【下一步：多元化】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他目前 focus："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Scaling core apps（subscriptions、MRR growth）", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Testing new directions and product ideas", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Experimenting with ASO、pricing、and distribution", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "长期目标是建 diversified business。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他不想 rely on single platform。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这意味着 spread risk across App Store、Google Play、SaaS。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Web 方面，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他已经 run 了两个 test launches。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "One 证明是 wrong direction，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " February shut down。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "另一个 gradually gaining traction——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "叫 Type.link 的 link-in-bio 和 website builder。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Over time，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他的 apps 会变得 platform-agnostic，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " available across all major platforms，including web。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "That way，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "they can grow——independent of any single ecosystem。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【你会从失败中重建吗？】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Viktor的故事告诉我们——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "失败不是终点。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "被封号不是终点。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "资金被冻结不是终点。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "只要你有 resilience，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有家人的支持，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有永不放弃的精神，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你可以重建——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一次又一次。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "从0到6万，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他走了三次。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你呢？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你有永不放弃的勇气吗？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "还是第一次失败就 quit 了？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "记住——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " "Never give up。Stay strong，even when things are hard。""}, {"insert": "

content_en: Apple Banned His Developer Account, He Rebuilt from Zero to $60K Monthly. Have you experienced your business completely collapsing overnight? Not market change. Not increased competition. Platform banned your account. Money frozen. In new country without access to your own money. Viktor Seraleev experienced this. This is one of his three times starting from zero. Now his app portfolio makes over $60K monthly. First he didn't know what he wanted to do. One thing clear: didn't want traditional 9-5 job. That left him no choice, had to become entrepreneur. Started offline businesses but over time gradually shifted focus to online products and digital businesses where he could build, iterate, scale on his own terms.
content_jp: アップルが開発者アカウントを禁止、彼はゼロから月間6万ドルに再構築。一夜にしてビジネスが完全に崩壊を経験したことがある？市場の变化じゃない。競争の激化じゃない。プラットフォームがアカウントを禁止した。お金が冻结。新国家で自分のお金にアクセスできない。Viktor Seraleev是这样经历的。これは彼の3回の「ゼロから」の中の一つ。今では彼のアプリポートフォリオは月間6万ドル以上作っている。最初は彼は何をしたいのか分からなかった。1つのことは明確——伝統的な9-5の仕事をしたくない。それは彼に選択肢を与えなかった、アントレプレナーになるしかなかった。オフラインンビジネスを始めたが、時間の経過とともにオンラインで製品やデジタルビジネスに gradually shiftした где он мог build、iterate、scale on his own terms。
content_ar: أبل حظر حساب المطور الخاص به، أعاد البناء من الصفر إلى 60 ألف دولار شهريًا. هل عانيت من انهيار عملك تمامًا بين عشية وضحاها؟ ليس تغيير السوق. ليس منافسة متزايدة. حظر المنصة حسابك. المال مجمد. في بلد جديد بدون الوصول إلى أموالك الخاصة. فيكتور سيرالييف عاش هذا. هذه واحدة من مرات ثلاث بدأ فيها من الصفر. الآن محفظة تطبيقاته تكسب أكثر من 60 ألف دولار شهريًا. أولاً لم يعرف ما يريد فعله. شيء واحد واضح: لم يرِد وظيفة تقليدية 9-5. لم يكن لديه خيار آخر، أصبح رائد أعمال. بدأ أعمال غير متصلة لكن مع مرور الوقت تحول تدريجيًا إلى منتجات عبر الإنترنت والأعمال الرقمية حيث يمكنه البناء والتكرار والتوسع بشروطه الخاصة.
